## Problem or missing workflow

Describe what a SickGamingBot user, staff member, or server owner is trying to accomplish.

## Proposed result

Explain what documentation, example, navigation, setup guidance, or bot behavior would help.

## Intended audience

- [ ] Member
- [ ] Moderator or delegated manager
- [ ] Administrator
- [ ] Discord server owner
- [ ] SickGamingBot maintainer

## Is bot implementation required?

- [ ] Documentation-only change
- [ ] Existing bot behavior needs clearer documentation
- [ ] New or changed cog behavior is required
- [ ] Unsure

Implementation work normally belongs in the [Sick-Cogs repository](/sickprodigy/Sick-Cogs). This issue can track the public-facing documentation relationship.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any existing command, help path, or workaround you tried.

## Additional context

Add sanitized examples or screenshots if useful. Never include credentials, private endpoints, Discord IDs, or private-channel content.
